description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and related components for a reminder table abstraction within the Orleans distributed framework. It includes grain interfaces for storage implementations, data classes for reminder entries, and associated methods for CRUD operations on reminders.

classes.name: ReminderTableData
classes.description: Represents a collection of reminder entries, providing constructors for different initialization scenarios and a ToString overload for display.

classes.name: ReminderEntry
classes.description: Defines a reminder table entry, including properties like grain ID, reminder name, start time, period, and ETag, with a method to convert to IGrainReminder.

classes.name: ReminderData
classes.description: Immutable class implementing IGrainReminder that encapsulates reminder data, including grain ID, reminder name, and ETag.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the reminder table, delegating to the obsolete Init method.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Obsolete initialization method returning a completed task.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries associated with a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminder entries within a specified hash range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry based on grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry, returning the new ETag.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry matching grain ID and reminder name, with concurrency control via ETag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all entries from the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.
